import json
p=currentProgram
af=p.getAddressFactory()

for start,n in [(0x14165dfe0,640),(0x14165e434,720),(0x14165e998,640),(0x14097dcc0,192),(0x14097e290,192)]:

 while a.getOffset()<end:
